instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina is a micro real estate brokerage with 8 offices and 85 agents, focusing on residential sales and light commercial leasing. The firm relies heavily on manual processes for market analysis and transaction management. We are currently evaluating AI-powered property valuation models to streamline reporting and reduce the high operational costs associated with traditional lead generation.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned, highlighting a critical lack of institutional memory for technology investment.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: We have a new CEO who joined 3 months ago from a more digitally mature industry. She has signaled that innovation and digital transformation will be top strategic priorities, replacing the previous leadership's conservative, cost-cutting orientation. The organization is cautiously optimistic but also uncertain about what concrete changes to expect.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Comparable Market Analysis Reporting
opportunities.rationale: Developing a standardized script to automate the generation of monthly comparable market analysis reports can significantly reduce manual agent time and improve data consistency across offices. This directly addresses the efficiency goal by lowering administrative overhead.

first_actions: Define required data inputs for the report template.
Identify a low-cost scripting solution (e.g., Python/Excel macro).
Pilot the automation with one office.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: 30% reduction in report generation time per week.
milestones: Q1: Script finalized and tested on one office.
Q2: Full deployment across all 8 offices.

opportunities.title: Standardized Agent Workflow Automation (CRM Lite)
opportunities.rationale: Implementing a simple, low-cost CRM that standardizes lead intake and agent task tracking will eliminate redundant manual processes and provide better visibility into bottlenecks. This supports the efficiency priority by ensuring agents focus on revenue-generating activities.

first_actions: Select an affordable SaaS CRM (e.g., HubSpot free tier).
Map out the top 5 manual agent tasks.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: 20% reduction in administrative time spent per agent.
milestones: Month 1: CRM selection and setup completed.
Month 3: Full rollout and adoption by all agents.

opportunities.title: **Hyper-Local Property Price Prediction Model (AI/ML)**
opportunities.rationale: To achieve bold efficiency gains, we should invest in a basic Machine Learning model that analyzes local micro-market data (school districts, zoning changes) to predict optimal pricing for properties. This would allow us to identify undervalued assets quickly before the competition.

first_actions: Identify and aggregate historical transaction data.
Hire or contract a freelance data scientist specializing in real estate ML (short-term).
Define scope limited to predicting price within 5 specific neighborhoods.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Founder time dedicated to project oversight
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve an accuracy of 80% in predicted property price variance within targeted neighborhoods.
milestones: Q1: Data pipeline established and model trained on pilot data.
Q3: Model deployment used for internal strategic pricing recommendations.

next_steps.action: Conduct a full process mapping exercise focused on identifying the top three highest-cost manual touchpoints across sales and administration.
Approve funding for the pilot Automated Comparable Market Analysis Script (Opportunity 1) to begin Q1 development.
Recruit or contract a consultant to provide external advisory support specifically for technology validation and risk mitigation on the 'Radical' opportunity.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formal institutional knowledge leading to reliance on informal processes and abandoned projects.
Low digital maturity (Level 1), hindering effective adoption and scaling of modern efficiency tools.
Decision-making bottleneck caused by owner dependency, risking slow adaptation to market changes in a high-pressure environment.
Inconsistent process documentation that makes it difficult to measure ROI or institutionalize successful incremental innovations.
